[Council File 20-1074-S5; CD 11]
Department of City Planning (DCP) report and recommendations dated May 28, 2026; DCP, Bureau of Engineering, and Department of Transportation (DOT) joint report and recommendations dated November 26, 2025; and DCP and DOT joint report, recommendations and Exhibits A, B, and C, dated August 12, 2026, relative to the Public Access Study and Mitigation Measures for the Venice Coastal Zone prepared to assist Al Fresco operators with their Coastal Development Permit applications and maintaining public access to the Venice Coastal Zone.
